gen_risks.description: Schools may struggle to deliver free breakfast clubs due to space constraints.
gen_risks.mitigation: Continuing contracts of technical estate advisers to test what schools can do to mitigate space constraints.

gen_risks.description: Rising food insecurity and childcare costs may impact the effectiveness of the programme.
gen_risks.mitigation: Monitoring food insecurity and childcare costs, and adjusting the programme accordingly.
gen_risks.evidence: rising food insecurity and childcare costs

gen_risks.description: The programme's success depends on timely approval and budget confirmation from HM Treasury.
gen_risks.mitigation: Close collaboration with HM Treasury to ensure timely approval and budget confirmation.
gen_risks.evidence: timely approval and budget confirmation from HM Treasury

gen_risks.description: Effective collaboration with sector partners is crucial for the programme's success.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establishing strong relationships with sector partners and ensuring effective communication.

gen_risks.description: The programme's funding model may not be sufficient to support all schools.
gen_risks.mitigation: Continuously monitoring the funding model and making adjustments as necessary.

gen_risks.description: The programme's success depends on the availability of skilled staff and resources.
gen_risks.mitigation: Ensuring the availability of skilled staff and resources through effective recruitment and retention strategies.
gen_risks.evidence: availability of skilled staff and resources

gen_risks.description: The programme may face challenges in delivering free breakfast clubs to all pupils, particularly those with high levels of disadvantage.
gen_risks.mitigation: Targeting support to schools with high levels of disadvantage and ensuring effective delivery models.
gen_risks.evidence: delivering free breakfast clubs to all pupils

gen_risks.description: The programme's evaluation strategy may not be effective in measuring the programme's outcomes.
gen_risks.mitigation: Continuously monitoring and evaluating the programme's evaluation strategy and making adjustments as necessary.

gen_risks.description: The programme may face logistical challenges in delivering free breakfast clubs, particularly in terms of food provision and staffing.
gen_risks.mitigation: Ensuring effective logistics and supply chain management, and providing support to schools on food provision and staffing.

gen_risks.description: The programme's success depends on the effective implementation of the Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill.
gen_risks.mitigation: Close collaboration with relevant stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of the Bill.

gen_risks.description: The programme may face challenges in transitioning schools from the National School Breakfast Programme (NSBP) to the Free Breakfast Clubs (FBC) programme.
gen_risks.mitigation: Providing support to schools during the transition period and ensuring effective communication.
gen_risks.evidence: transitioning schools from NSBP to FBC

gen_risks.description: The programme's funding may not be sufficient to support the increased demand for free breakfast clubs.
gen_risks.mitigation: Continuously monitoring the funding and making adjustments as necessary to ensure sufficient support for the programme.

gt_risks.description: Lower value for money compared to the 'do minimum' option in year 1, due to the shorter funding period available for the preferred option's new cohorts of schools.
Delivery risks around staffing and food costs for schools newly onboarded to the free breakfast clubs programme.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated through early adopter (EA) scheme insights and support funding.

gt_risks.description: Uncertainty in the labour-market benefits (parental workforce participation gains) the programme is expected to deliver.
gt_risks.mitigation: Addressed through conservative assumptions in the economic modelling.
